submitted.rationale: Out of 5 EQE measurements, index 6 (Sb=0.247) was the only composition with clearly non-zero EQE: 0.040%. The others measured were ~0 or negative. The 0.25 composition is on the Co-rich side of the line, where Co3SbO8 / Co7Sb2O12 (spinel-type) phases sit. XRD on 4, 6 and 8 was dominated by the Pt substrate reflections, so the phases could not be told apart.

rejected.reason: EQE ~0 even though it is next to index 6, so the active window is narrow
